g.text: CAN: primary host link, 29-bit IDs. Host source >=8 when commanding LTM dest 0/3.

g.desc: CAN: primary host link, 29-bit IDs. Host source >=8 when commanding LTM dest 0/3.

g.text: UMBILICAL: Attached high on bench/USB, low in flight; inhibits transmit and gates loader behavior.

g.desc: UMBILICAL: Attached high on bench/USB, low in flight; inhibits transmit and gates loader behavior.

g.text: TLM/GPIO/I2C: TLM1-4 are 0-3.3V or GND if unused. LTM is I2C master; expose reset as needed.

g.desc: TLM/GPIO/I2C: TLM1-4 are 0-3.3V or GND if unused. LTM is I2C master; expose reset as needed.

g.text: POWER: switched VSYS 5.0V +/-5%, size for ~2.9W max.

g.desc: POWER: switched VSYS 5.0V +/-5%, size for ~2.9W max.

g.text: Keep LTM unpowered until transmit-safe and antennas deployed.

g.desc: Keep LTM unpowered until transmit-safe and antennas deployed.

g.text: Confirm final connector geometry from LTM LIHU Gerbers/KiCad.

g.desc: Confirm final connector geometry from LTM LIHU Gerbers/KiCad.

g.text: RF: host must provide 50R VHF and UHF antenna paths to LTM coax/SMA interfaces.

g.desc: RF: host must provide 50R VHF and UHF antenna paths to LTM coax/SMA interfaces.

g.text: LEGACY RADIO REVIEW: U4 RFM98PW + RF1 MMCX area should be replaced or isolated for LTM host use.
